task: ae.layout.Breaker and TextJustifier: optimal line breaking and monospaced justification with a brute-force oracle
reasoning_summary: Implemented total-fit Knuth-Plass breaking as a DP over active nodes keyed by (index, line, flagged) with exact integer badness, pruning and uniform-line merging. Tests were written first: hand-derived demerit fixtures, a BigInteger brute-force oracle over 1500 seeded instances, rendering property tests and mutation checks. The first run exposed an active-set blowup (line number in the key), an over-infeasible generator and a test-side space-collapse bug.
